purpose: n8n webhook workflow that validates an enquiry payload, normalises phone/email, deduplicates by tenant + contact, persists the lead and emits a lead.created event.

configurationFields.description: n8n webhook path, unique per tenant
Same contact within window updates the existing lead
GOOGLE_SHEETS_OAUTH_REF when Google Sheets is a target

permissionsRequired: Insert/update on the tenant's leads table
Append rows to the client's lead sheet (if selected)

testCases.expectedOutcome: 200 with leadId; one row in leads with tenant_id set

testCases.description: POST the same contact twice within the dedupe window
testCases.expectedOutcome: Second response duplicate=true; still one lead row

testCases.description: POST a payload missing a required field
POST with a tenantId that does not match the webhook path

knownLimitations: Contract only: n8n blueprint JSON not yet built and exported (Phase B).
rollbackApproach: Deactivate the workflow in n8n and re-import the previous exported version; the form falls back to the API's own persistence.
